package.title: Carbon Icons
package.description: IBM's Carbon Design System icons: the full set at 32 px and the 16 px redraws.

size-32.name: 32 px
size-32.description: The full set, drawn on the 32 px grid

size-16.name: 16 px
size-16.description: Glyphs redrawn for 16 px, where upstream ships one

update_command._note: icon-sets-sync has no config/icon-sets-carbon.json yet; the proposed recipe is pack-recipes/icon-sets-carbon.json in the ichava design folder, and lands with the one icon-sets-sync pull request that adds the v0.1.0 packs. Until then the weekly sync-upstream run has nothing to run.

upstream._subset: Sizes 32 and 16 only. Dropped: size 20 (9 files), size 24 (8 files) and the 18 unsized status glyphs at the root of `svg/`. Names are slugged (`chevron--down` is `chevron-down`); the `watson-health/` and `Q/` namespaces become name prefixes (`watson-health-study-view`, `q-h`). No two names collide after slugging.
